about_the_game:
Survive the Rift is a roguelike shoot 'em up with procedurally generated levels, unlockable ships, and plenty of items to make each run unique.

Inspired by classic 16-bit era scrolling shooters with modern roguelike game mechanics.

Features

  • Unlock ships with different starting weapons and stats.

  • Choose your path through each sector. Select the type and difficulty of stage you want to play. Risk a hard stage to earn more credits and technology or visit a shop to get repairs and outfit your ship with new technology.

  • Destroy enemies to get loot. Find new weapons, modules, devices, and ship upgrades.

This demo version of Surive the Rift includes all of the content in the first sector and two playable ships (the starting ship plus one unlockable ship). Technology upgrades (meta-progression) are not avaialable in the demo.
